svg.title: Pimp My 3MF
svg.desc: Three staggered lines of golden yellow retro script with blue outlines and thick deep navy dimensional shadows. Transparent background. Editable vector paths, with separate lettering and shadow layers. No fonts or raster images required.
svg.metadata: Text: Pimp My 3MF. Gold #FFCD00. Blue #1E4FA0. Navy #0B2560. Lettering is outlined for portable vector editing.
